first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and simplifying onboarding has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. Verify memory_86 because it is most directly consequential to the immediate diagnosis; verify memory_73 to assess whether targeted pricing is a stronger sustainable-revenue response to the competitor threat. Choose onboarding over discounts because it addresses durable product value rather than relying on price concessions, while guarding against gains in completion that do not translate into qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the confirmed evidence that it increases completion by 13%, reduces time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improves 30-day retention by 3%. This directly addresses both current declines in onboarding completion and activation while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification provides additional directional support, but should not be treated as independently verified. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue 18% short term, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Track activation, qualified pipeline/revenue, and renewal-quality outcomes so improved funnel metrics are not mistaken for durable value.
